description: This file sets up initial agriculture-related data records in an ERP system, including item groups and analysis criteria for various agricultural parameters.

methods.name: setup_agriculture
methods.description: Checks if agriculture analysis criteria are already set up; if not, calls create_agriculture_data to initialize data.

methods.name: create_agriculture_data
methods.description: Creates and inserts a comprehensive list of item groups and agriculture analysis criteria records into the system.
